note: head of a list of 8-byte nodes {next, amount} (stack_adjust_node in types_proposal.h): stack pointer changes not visible as immediates (large frame allocate/free, add Rn,r15 after a MOVI, runtime routine adjustments), appended at the tail only when request+0x16 is set; would be stack_adjust_node *

name: g_current_section_kind
note: section kind 0..3 of the current output (indexes g_section_location_counter, PTR_DAT_0043cef8, picks DAT_0044e028/2a/2c/2e in build_section_select_record)

name: g_debug_location_hash
note: array of 0x7f x 4 bytes (debug_location * buckets, key id % 0x7f; FUN_00401000 fills, FUN_00401655 frees, emit_block_scope_records looks up)

name: g_ofb_input
note: the .ofb layout stream (request+0x90, or +0x94 when request+4 != 0), opened by begin_layout_passes, read by layout_next_ofb_record / read_ofb_layout_record, closed by finish_layout_passes

name: g_object_record_buffer
note: the object record being built (translate_* / emit_object_header_and_tables) before append_object_record_bytes; 0x100 bytes up to g_listing_code_row_next

name: g_listing_code_row_next
note: Next row of g_listing_code_rows that flush_listing_line prints; 0 after flush_listing_entry.

name: g_listing_code_rows
note: array of N x 10 bytes: the rows of the listing's object-code column (append_listing_object_code); flushed by FUN_0042b69d

name: g_runtime_routine_imported
note: array of 0x20 x 1 byte: bitmap of runtime routines already imported by name (emit_import_symbol sets, run_assembler_passes clears)

name: g_ofb_current_label
note: the label number of the last label record read from .ofb; run_layout_passes reads records when the symbol walk reaches it

name: g_delay_slot_record
note: psd (0x18 bytes): the record held for a branch's delay slot; emit_final_asm_record_stream prints it after each branch (an OP_NOP placeholder gets the branch's expno/filno/linno) and then clears it from g_zero_psd

name: g_pipeline_window
note: [pipetbl] the list scheduler's window: load_pipeline_window fills entries 0..g_pipeline_window_last_index (at most 32) with backend records; dump_pipeline_table prints it

name: g_runtime_routines_used
note: array of 0x20 x 1 byte: bitmap (MSB first, bit n = routine n+1) of runtime routines the code uses, read from the .asb trailer record 0xe (load_intermediate_record_stream)

name: g_expanded_records
note: array of 48 x 0x18 bytes (psd [48]; next global 00449730): records queued by the per-op expanders (set_psd_record at +n*0x18; ea1 at 004492c0, ea2 at 004492c4, flg at 004492b1 are the same array); read_next_backend_record returns them in order (read index 00441dd0) and clears each with g_zero_psd

name: g_source_listing_at_end
note: 1 once g_source_listing_input hit EOF (copy_source_lines_to_listing; emit_final_asm_record_stream stops calling it)

name: g_pipeline_last_scheduled
note: window index of the entry scheduled last (commit_scheduled_pipeline_entry links the next one after it), -1 none

name: g_pipeline_load_result_regs
note: array of 2 x 4 bytes (00449738 word 0, 0044973c word 1): setreg of the last committed record when it accessed memory through ea1 (a load) or is an FPU op, else 0; can_schedule_pipeline_entry_now refuses an entry using any of these registers (load-use interlock). Ghidra shows 00449738 as _DAT_ (overlapping symbol)

name: g_function_label
note: label of the function being emitted: read_next_backend_record stores the label of an OP_FLABEL record; the expanders find the function's aux record through it

name: g_debug_scope_depth
note: scope nesting of the debug records: emit_final_object_file sets -1, translate_scope_record ++ on begin / -- on end; translate_debug_symbol_record stores it in debug_symbol+0xc and writes it into each record

name: g_source_listing_input
note: request+0x15c: {file (2), line (4)} headers and source text lines that copy_source_lines_to_listing interleaves into the listing

name: g_pipeline_edges
note: the window's dependency edges, allocated in order (g_pipeline_edge_count, add_pipeline_dependency_edge stops at 0x3e0); 0x3e0 * 4 bytes ends at 0044a6d0 where the next global starts

name: g_inline_asm_needs_label
note: set after an inline asm block; label and section records clear it; when set, the next block first gets a fresh label

name: g_backend_record_input
note: the backend record stream (.sua/.sub, request+0x84/+0x88) opened by run_assembler_passes; read by read_label_ref_list, emit_reserve_record, emit_string_data_record, print_label_sum_from_backend_stream; closed by emit_final_asm_record_stream

name: g_next_import_index
note: run_assembler_passes clears it; FUN_004017a0 stores it per imported symbol (symbol+0x28, g_runtime_routine_import_index) and increments it

name: g_new_symbol_count
note: run_assembler_passes clears it; the label-name writers (FUN_004232ef / FUN_00426e2d) count each label definition; store_request_record_updates writes it to request->label_count (s04, s08)

name: g_word_literal_table_pass1
note: literal_table of the word literals of layout pass 1 (add_literal_to_pool_table pass 1)

name: g_superscalar_current_entry
note: window index of the entry being described: FUN_00404f53 loops it 0..g_pipeline_window_last_index around describe_superscalar_window_entry; FUN_0040ad6c/0040b055/0040b33e index the window with it (byte accesses)

name: g_export_symbol_count
note: exports: read from the .asb trailer (load_intermediate_record_stream), decremented by count_import_and_export_symbols for exports that are not emitted; object header (FUN_00412b7c) and request +0xe8

name: g_current_aux_index
note: Aux record index of the current function (symbol +0x10). Read as short everywhere; FUN_0042926d writes it as a 4-byte int, so the type is left empty (2 or 4 bytes: lead decide).

name: g_inline_asm_input
note: request+0xa0, opened by run_assembler_passes when request+0x12 == 2 (source output); emit_inline_asm_block seeks to a block's offset and copies its text

name: g_symbol_table
note: the symbol entries loaded from the stream: FUN_00435550(request +0xac, 0x2c), array of N x 0x2c bytes (symbol_entry)

name: g_register_candidates
note: list of 0x10-byte register_candidate nodes, built and freed inside update_register_variable_map

name: g_long_literal_table_pass1
note: literal_table of the long literals of layout pass 1

name: g_backend_continuation_opened
note: cleared by run_assembler_passes; read_next_backend_record sets 1 when g_backend_input hits end of file and it reopens g_backend_input on request+0x8c (the .sud continuation per notes), so that happens once

name: g_pipeline_hold
note: tested by run_pipeline_until_stable (refill only while 0) and cleared by reset_pipeline_state; no write of a nonzero value anywhere in the binary (always 0)

name: g_pipeline_input_exhausted
note: 1: the input ended (load_pipeline_window returned 0, or no lookahead record and no C_JMP); run_pipeline_until_stable then sets g_pipeline_end_of_stream instead of loading again. Written in pipeline, cleared in reset_pipeline_state

name: g_pipeline_mac_busy
note: cycles the multiplier stays busy: commit_scheduled_pipeline_entry sets 2 after MUL/MULS/MULU/MAC, 0 after LDS/STS MACH/MACL or a label, else counts down; while nonzero can_schedule_pipeline_entry_now refuses MUL..MAC and LDS/STS MACH/MACL

name: g_extra_section_needed
note: 1 when some symbol (not flag 0x40, attr & 3) exists and the second section group's size[2] (+0x10) is 0: that group then gets a section number for kind 2 and its own header entry and section definition (run_assembler_passes, emit_object_header_and_tables, emit_final_asm_record_stream)

name: g_string_pool_end
note: end of the current string pool block (block + 0x104)

name: g_last_attributed_symbol
note: the last loaded symbol that has attribute bytes (kind > 6) or a section record; at end of stream, if still the first entry, set to the last loaded entry

name: g_stack_pointer_offset
note: offset of R15 within the current function (<= 0 when logged), recomputed at labels, tracked per instruction

name: g_symbol_hash
note: array of 0x3fd x 4 bytes: symbol_entry * bucket heads, bucket = id % 0x3fd, chained through +0x14 (load_intermediate_record_stream clears and fills, find_symbol_entry_by_id, create_symbol_entry)

name: g_pipeline_drained_count
note: records drained from the window (read_next_scheduled_pipeline_record increments, reset_pipeline_state clears); never read. The 0x3fd-word g_symbol_hash ends exactly here

name: g_listing_code_column_pos
note: Character position (0..10) within the current code row; 10 = row full (flush_listing_entry resets to 10).

name: g_current_section
note: the section switch_section made current (find_section_by_id). asm_section *

name: g_scope_stack
note: array of debug_range * (types_proposal.h) indexed by g_scope_depth; roots allocated by init_debug_info_state; at most 0x11c bytes before 0044bc4c (0044bb34 is element [1]; 0044bb2c is a separate global that Ghidra also uses as element [-1])

name: g_pipeline_first_scheduled
note: window index of the first scheduled entry (commit_scheduled_pipeline_entry sets it when the list is empty; read_next_scheduled_pipeline_record drains from it, following pipeline_entry.next), -1 none

name: g_scope_top
note: index of the current scope in g_scope_stack (FUN_0041e360 sets 1; ++ on a scope begin, -- on an end)

name: g_listing_code_row_last
note: Last filled row of g_listing_code_rows; 0xffff (-1) = none (flush_listing_entry, 004131a0).

name: g_object_data_cursor
note: write cursor of g_object_data_buffer (FUN_00402a55 appends, FUN_00402ab2 resets to the base after flushing it as a tag-0x20 record)

name: g_import_symbol_count
note: imports counted by count_import_and_export_symbols; written to the object header (FUN_00412b7c) and request +0xe4

name: g_object_data_end
note: end of g_object_data_buffer (open_output_stream)

name: g_source_line_list
note: list head of 0x18-byte source_line_range nodes (types_proposal.h): record_source_line_range / flush_source_line_ranges, and the .LINE dedup list of emit_line_directive_if_new / free_line_directive_list

name: g_pipeline_window_ends_block
note: 1: the window ends a basic block (last entry a branch/RTS/RTE/TRAPA, ended with C_JMP, or the lookahead is a label); the next window is then loaded lazily (g_pipeline_reload_pending). Set in pipeline, cleared in reset_pipeline_state

name: g_symbol_table_next
note: next free symbol_entry slot while loading (advances 0x2c after every record with a kind)

name: g_aux_record_table
note: Array of request +0x110 x 0x44-byte per-function aux records (calloc in load_intermediate_record_stream); shcpep's struct aux_record (types_proposal.h). Type aux_record * once the struct is adopted.

name: g_superscalar_records_read
note: records read into SH-4 windows since emit_final_asm_record_stream cleared it (0 = reset the window state)

name: g_object_data_buffer
note: allocated by open_output_stream(1) (stream size - 3 bytes); FUN_00402ab2 writes its contents as a tag-0x20 record; freed by close_output_stream(1)

name: g_expno_use_list
note: list of 0xc-byte expno_use nodes (next, expno, short count), descending expno; built per range by update_debug_info_for_record, consumed by update_register_variable_map

name: g_lit_input
note: shcpep's .lit stream (opened from request+0xa4 in run_assembler_passes): one byte per branch/return; 1 = the literal pool goes after it, applied as flg 0x10 on the expanded branch

name: g_pipeline_lookahead_record
note: a backend record read past the end of the window, kept for the next load_pipeline_window (valid when g_pipeline_lookahead_valid)

name: g_object_expr_cursor
note: write cursor of g_object_expr_buffer (append_reloc_expression_bytes appends, message 0x1360 when full; called with 0 it moves the contents to g_object_data_buffer; emit_relocation_expression keeps a record's length byte position and patches it)

name: g_superscalar_window
note: array of 32 x 0xe0 bytes (struct sched_entry, types_proposal.h); ends at 0044d8b0 where the next global starts. read_next_pipeline_buffered_backend_record copies each backend record (0x18 bytes) into entry g_pipeline_window_last_index and FUN_0040b3e0 fills +0x1a..+0x1d. The DAT_0044bcb1..DAT_0044bd8c labels in s02's functions are its fields (base+0x01..base+0xdc). Used when request +0x18 == 4 (read_next_backend_record), the SH-4 path by the opcodes/registers it models.

name: g_object_expr_end
note: end of the relocation expression buffer (compared as an int with pos; error 0x1360)

name: g_pipeline_end_of_stream
note: 1: the scheduler has no more records: read_next_scheduled_pipeline_record returns 0 and read_next_backend_record ends its loop. Set when the window is empty (last index -1) or by run_pipeline_until_stable once g_pipeline_input_exhausted; cleared by reset_pipeline_state, emit_final_asm_record_stream, read_next_backend_record

name: g_source_listing_line
note: line number of the next source line header (4 bytes read; compared with an unsigned short line)

name: g_line_range_temp
note: temp file (FUN_0042f040) of source line records (flush_source_line_ranges); read back by FUN_00411d44

name: g_register_variable_input
note: request->reg_path (.reg, written by shcgen) opened "rb" by init_debug_info_state when request->optimize; read by load_function_register_variable_map; closed in emit_debug_information

name: g_pipeline_edge_count
note: edges of g_pipeline_edges used (reset_pipeline_state clears it; add_pipeline_dependency_edge increments it, at most 0x3e0)

name: g_pipeline_reload_pending
note: 1: load the next window (pipeline()) at the next read_next_scheduled_pipeline_record instead of right away; set by run_pipeline_until_stable when the drained window ended a block (g_pipeline_window_ends_block). read_next_pipeline_buffered_backend_record (the other reader) uses it as "the buffered window is full, flush it"

name: g_object_expr_buffer
note: start of the relocation expression buffer

name: g_layout_shrink_pass0
note: bytes layout pass 0 has removed so far in the current section (shcpep's size estimates minus the real sizes): subtracted from every label position and record location; saved in / reloaded from the section layout record +0x28 on a section change. The SHC_ALIGN_FILE knob takes its pad off this value

name: g_layout_shrink_pass1
note: the same for layout pass 1 (section layout record +0x2c)

name: g_listing_page_line_count
note: lines on the current listing page; a new page (FUN_0042b864, which resets it to 1) past request+0xc - 4

name: g_string_pool_blocks
note: head of the 0x104-byte string pool blocks (+0 next) (store_string_in_pool, free_debug_symbol_table)

name: g_listing_continuation_mark
note: Position in the listing line (buffer +0x18, 004131a0) where put_text_at_column stores '+' on a continuation line.

name: g_line_range_count
note: source line records written to g_line_range_temp (fatal 0xc82 when it would pass 0xffff)

name: g_superscalar_entry_stage_pattern
note: array of 32 x 4 bytes (int per window entry): written by set_sched_entry_timing, printed by dump_sched_window as g_stage_pattern_names[(char)value]

name: g_pipeline_fsqrt_busy
note: set to 4 after FSQRT; otherwise as g_pipeline_fdiv_busy

name: g_pipeline_fdiv_busy
note: set to 4 after FDIV, counted down by non-FPU ops, cleared by other FPU ops and labels; while it or g_pipeline_fsqrt_busy is nonzero FPU ops (0xb0..0xdf) are refused

name: g_line_wrap_disabled
note: 1 while FUN_00426e2d writes a long line to channel 2: put_text_at_column then neither moves to the column start nor breaks at ',', it just writes the full buffer out; 0 otherwise.

name: g_literal_pool_label
note: label number of the current literal pool: read (2 bytes, byte-swapped by FUN_0042efb0) from the branch-form stream when both literal tables are empty; @(disp,PC) operands refer to it, disp computed from its symbol (+0x24 minus +0x08) and the literal index

name: g_object_record_break
note: 1 forces FUN_00402374 to start a new object data record (set by emit_reserve_record / emit_literal_pool when a location counter jumps)

name: g_listing_page_number
note: Listing page number (emit_listing_page_header increments; 004131a0 clears).

name: g_section_count
note: next section number; run_assembler_passes assigns numbers to the used (group, kind) pairs; written into the 0x30 and tag-6 records

name: g_superscalar_dump_file
note: stream of the dump_sched_window / print_sched_entry_operands debug output (only fputs uses; never assigned in the export)

name: g_section_object_offsets
note: array of 4 x 4 bytes (per kind), advanced with the location counter in object mode (emit_reserve_record, emit_literal_pool) and saved/restored with the section (switch_section); written into object data records by FUN_00402374

name: g_function_label_pass0
note: label (symbol number) of the function layout pass 0 is in: the last FLABEL read from .ofb (layout_next_ofb_record, begin_layout_passes); relax_exit_record / relax_return_record find the function's aux record through it

name: g_expanded_record_count
note: records queued in g_expanded_records; every expander increments it; read_next_backend_record resets it with the read index once all are returned

name: g_request_copy
note: The request pointer (shcasm_main stores g_current_request here); read at +0x1a (pic), +0x13d, +0x14b by decide_literal_pool_placement and compute_record_code_size. Same type as g_current_request.

name: g_runtime_routine_import_index
note: array of 0x100 x 4 bytes: import number given to each runtime routine imported by name (emit_import_symbol; emit_runtime_routine_imports copies it to the symbol +0x28)

name: g_zero_psd
note: an all-zero backend record copied over a record buffer to clear it (load_pipeline_window, read_next_backend_record)

name: g_backend_first_record
note: buffer handed to FUN_00402b00 / FUN_00425fbc by run_assembler_passes, whose first byte is the first byte of g_backend_input; size not established from this slice

name: g_expno_register_variables
note: array of (count+1) x 4 bytes (calloc via FUN_00435550): per expression number a list of 8-byte register_variable nodes (load_function_register_variable_map; freed by free_expno_register_variable_table)

name: g_section_data_bytes
note: bytes of data records since the last section select (build_section_select_record clears, finish_object_record adds)

name: g_object_record_tag
note: tag of the object record FUN_00402374 is filling (a different tag flushes the current one via FUN_0040266b); run_assembler_passes sets 0

name: g_function_label_pass1
note: label of the function layout pass 1 is in (the last kind-1 symbol the pass-1 walk passed; resolve_next_pending_layout_record)

name: g_layout_symbol_pending_records
note: pass 2's next layout_record of the current symbol (FUN_0042ac37; begin_layout_passes clears it)

name: g_pipeline_code_offset
note: low byte of the instruction offset while scheduling: seeded from the low byte of a label symbol's position (+8) when a label is committed, +2 per instruction, +4 per branch with delay slot, B_ASM pads to 0 mod 4; can_schedule_pipeline_entry_now tests it mod 4 against pipeline_entry_uses_memory_stage. Byte global (used signed: (int)char)

name: g_register_map_temp
note: temp file of register/variable maps (4-byte entries, 0xffff terminated) from update_register_variable_map / flush_register_variable_map; read back by FUN_0041013c

name: g_superscalar_stream_ended
note: 1: end of stream reached with records left in the window (read_next_pipeline_buffered_backend_record; read_next_backend_record stops calling it)

name: g_section_numbers
note: array of 4 x 2 bytes, per-kind shorts saved to / loaded from section_layout +0 by switch_section and emit_final_asm_record_stream

name: g_debug_record_cursor
note: read cursor in the .db1 record body (emit_debug_information sets it to g_debug_record_body for each record; the translate_* functions advance it)

name: g_debug_record_tag
note: tag byte of the .db1 record emit_debug_information read from g_debug_record_input (0x32, 0x34, 0x36, 0x44, 0x48, 0x4a, 0x4c, 0x4e, 0x50; bit 0x80 also passed to append_object_record_bytes); 0044e041 is the record length, 0044e042 the body

name: g_temp_record_length
note: length byte of that record (header included: body = length - 2)

name: g_debug_record_body
note: body of the .db1 record emit_debug_information read (record length - 2 bytes, at most 0xfd); g_debug_record_cursor walks it

name: g_listing_section_field
note: listing line +0 (open_output_stream); FUN_00423287 copies up to 3 characters of a section name (FUN_00427d94) there

name: g_string_pool_pos
note: next free byte of the current string pool block

name: g_debug_function_label
note: label of the function whose debug records are being written/translated (update_debug_info_for_record at FLABEL; translate_debug_symbol_record for a kind-3 symbol record)

name: g_symbol_base
note: the symbol record array again (load_intermediate_record_stream stores the same allocation as g_symbol_table): run_assembler_passes indexes it, begin_layout_passes walks from it

name: g_listing_code_field
note: listing line +0xd (open_output_stream): 10 characters of object code; FUN_0042b69d copies overflow rows from 00448240 into it

name: g_object_record_cursor
note: write cursor in g_object_record_buffer (set to its start per record; record length = cursor - buffer)

name: g_layout_record_tail
note: last layout_record appended for the current symbol (read_ofb_layout_record; run_layout_passes clears it per label). layout_record *

name: g_superscalar_order
note: array of 32 x 0xc bytes (struct sched_order_slot, types_proposal.h): filled and sorted by path length in schedule_superscalar_window; .cycle (0044e168) is also written per entry by compute_original_order_issue_cycles

name: g_register_sort_buffer
note: array of 0x18 x 1 byte: scratch copy of an entry's register list sorted by build_sh4_dependency_graph

name: g_lib_env_name_00
note: SHC_LIB / "SHCPP_LIB" (select_env_variable_names).

name: g_lib_env_name_04
note: SHC_LIB / "SHCPP_LIB".

name: g_tmp_env_name
note: SHC_TMP or "SHCPP_TMP" (FUN_00434d30): the environment variable naming the temp directory (make_temp_file_name).

name: g_lib_env_name_0c
note: SHC_LIB / "SHCPP_LIB".

name: g_lib_env_name_10
note: SHC_LIB / "SHCPP_LIB".

name: g_inc_env_name
note: SHC_INC / "SHCPP_INC".

name: g_request_trailer_file
note: Temp file with the bytes after the request (save_request_trailer_to_temp), NULL if none. Same name as s12.

name: g_request_version_mismatch
note: 1 when a C request's +0x11c/+0x120 strings differ from this binary's (read_request_variable_part); load_request_record_file then fails with 0xceb. shcpep 0042ae38.

name: g_request_cpp_block_size
note: Byte size of the C++ block at request+0x144 (read_request_cpp_block). Same name as s12.

name: g_demangle_token_pool
note: char pool of token texts (intern_token_text). Array of 0x400 bytes (to 0044e730).

name: g_demangle_tokens
note: array of 256 x 8 bytes {short kind; char *text} (demangle_argument_list: kind 1 'F', 2 '_' return separator, 3 complete type, 0 consumed). Ends at 0044ef30.

name: g_demangle_placeholder_types
note: array of 256 x 8 bytes {short used; char *text}: the function-type text each "$$nnn" stands for (demangle_argument_list writes, format_placeholder_type reads). Ends at 0044f730.

name: g_demangle_piece_chunk_first
note: First 0x808-byte chunk {next, used, data[0x800]} of the type-piece string chain (allocate_/free_demangle_string_chunks). Would be demangle_string_chunk * (types_proposal.h).

name: g_demangle_piece_chunk_current
note: Chunk alloc_type_piece_string copies into.

name: g_demangle_backref_chunk_first
note: First chunk of the back-reference string chain.

name: g_demangle_backref_chunk_current
note: Chunk alloc_back_reference_string copies into.

name: g_demangle_placeholder_name_pool_used
note: Bytes used in g_demangle_placeholder_name_pool. NOTE: compose_type_pieces' Ghidra C indexes "&DAT_0044f740 + n*2" as an int array, that is g_demangle_type_pieces[n-2].kind, not this variable.

note: array of 256 x 8 bytes {short kind; char *text} (push_type_piece, compose_type_pieces; kind 2 type/name, 7 member pointer). Ends at 0044ff50. 0044f748/0044f74c/0044f754 in the C are fields of its entries.

name: g_demangle_back_reference_count
note: Entries of g_demangle_back_references used (remember_argument_type); format_mangled_type_list resets it.

name: g_demangle_token_pool_used
note: Bytes used in g_demangle_token_pool; demangle_argument_list resets it.

name: g_demangle_placeholder_chunk_first
note: First 0x804-byte chunk {next, data[0x800]} of the placeholder text chain (demangle_argument_list allocates it and frees the chain at the end).

name: g_demangle_placeholder_chunk_current
note: Chunk alloc_placeholder_type_string copies into.

name: g_demangle_placeholder_chunk_used
note: Bytes used in g_demangle_placeholder_chunk_current.

name: g_work_buffer_a_capacity
note: Allocated size of g_work_buffer_a (initialize_work_buffers 0x400; append_to_work_buffer doubles it). Work buffer 1 = the demangled name.

name: g_work_buffer_b_capacity
note: As g_work_buffer_a_capacity for buffer 2 (argument list / conversion type text).

name: g_work_buffer_b_length
note: As g_work_buffer_a_length for buffer 2.

name: g_work_buffer_c_capacity
note: As g_work_buffer_a_capacity for buffer 3 (nested function type arguments in demangle_argument_list).

name: g_work_buffer_c_length
note: As g_work_buffer_a_length for buffer 3; demangle_argument_list fails when it passes 0x400.

name: g_demangle_placeholder_name_pool
note: char pool of the "$$nnn" names (intern_placeholder_name). Array of 0x400 bytes (to 004503a0).

name: g_demangle_back_references
note: array of 256 x 8 bytes {short used; char *text}: formatted argument types for "T<n>" (remember_argument_type, format_type_back_reference reads entry n-1 via 00450398/0045039c). Ends at 00450ba0.

name: g_demangle_placeholder_count
note: Next "$$nnn" number (demangle_argument_list).

name: stock_nhandle
note: [crt] _nhandle (number of ioinfo entries; +32 per block: stock_ioinit, stock_alloc_osfhnd).

name: stock_pioinfo
note: [crt] __pioinfo: array of 64 x 4-byte pointers to 32-entry blocks of 8-byte ioinfo {osfhnd, osfile, pipech}, up to 00450cb0 (stock_alloc_osfhnd's bound). stock_ioinit writes 00450bb4.. for the second block on.

name: stock_crtheap
note: [crt] _crtheap HANDLE (HeapCreate in stock_heap_init; HeapAlloc/HeapFree/HeapReAlloc).

name: stock_nstream
note: [crt] _nstream (stream table size; __getstream, stock_rmtmp, stock_fcloseall).

name: stock_piob
note: [crt] __piob (pointer to the FILE * table; stock_flsall walks 512 entries).

name: stock_acmdln
note: [crt] _acmdln = GetCommandLineA() (entry; __setargv).

name: stock_onexitend
note: [crt] __onexitend (stock_doexit walks back from it).

name: stock_fpinit
note: [crt] _FPinit function pointer (stock_cinit calls it when set).

name: stock_onexitbegin
note: [crt] __onexitbegin (stock_doexit).
